title: Build a hiring pipeline
summary: Configure multi-role hiring with structured interviews, scorecards, offer approval workflows, and diversity tracking.

parts.title: Define interview stages per role type
parts.guidance: Design interview stages around the capabilities each role type requires. Assign a purpose, interviewer, evidence and decision owner to every stage, removing duplicate assessments. Define how candidates hear about progress, request accommodations, pause or withdraw. Walk the planned handoffs with hiring managers and recruiting so the process is workable before candidates enter it.

references.title: EEOC: Recruiting, hiring or promoting employees

execution.rationale: Draft role-specific interview stages, evidence requirements and candidate handoffs for recruiting review.

parts.title: Create job postings
parts.guidance: Write each posting from the requisition’s responsibilities, location, compensation guidance and essential requirements. Check questions and disclosures with the people lead for the recruiting locations involved, and have the hiring manager settle factual differences before publication. Verify that applications reach the correct recruiter. Keep postings aligned with changes in role scope, budget or hiring status.

references.title: EEOC: Recruiting, hiring or promoting employees

execution.rationale: Lever's job-posting editor supports publication and requisition routing after hiring and local-content review.

parts.title: Configure scorecard templates
parts.guidance: Translate interview criteria into role-specific scorecards, giving each interviewer the competencies they can assess. Explain rating levels and ask for evidence, concerns and unanswered questions. Compare sample evaluations with the hiring manager to catch inconsistent interpretation. Make sure the debrief view preserves the reasoning behind ratings so the team can discuss the candidate’s actual fit for the work.

references.title: EEOC: Recruiting, hiring or promoting employees

execution.rationale: Draft competency scorecards and rating examples from the approved interview criteria.

parts.title: Set up offer approval workflow
parts.guidance: Map the actual decision rights for headcount, compensation, equity, unusual terms and offer release. Configure approvers and substitutes around those limits, including what happens when an already approved offer changes. Walk through approval, rejection and revision with recruiting and finance before use. The recruiter should be able to identify which exact terms are cleared to send and which still need a decision.

execution.rationale: Lever documents configuring offer approval chains, conditions and substitutes; approvers retain their actual decisions.

parts.title: Connect Calendly for scheduling
parts.guidance: Connect the scheduling tool using the calendar access authorized by the interviewer and account owners. Configure interview lengths, availability, time zones and candidate messages around the planned stages. Check a booking, reschedule and cancellation, including what personal information appears in invitations. Give candidates and interviewers a support route when conflicts or integration failures require manual scheduling.

execution.rationale: Calendly documents event types, availability and calendar connections for authorized interview scheduling.

parts.title: Configure Slack hiring channels
parts.guidance: Set up hiring channels for the people coordinating each role, with candidate evaluations and compensation kept in the appropriate restricted systems. Check membership and notification content before enabling a recruiting integration. Verify what a candidate update reveals and who can see it. Assign a channel owner to adjust access and close or repurpose the space when hiring pauses or ends.

execution.rationale: Slack channel APIs cover the room, but the recruiting event connector and its delivery tests are not established.

parts.title: Set up diversity tracking
parts.guidance: Define the reporting purpose before choosing demographic fields. Ask the people or privacy lead what collection, notices, access and retention are appropriate in each location. Keep approved reporting data separate from individual selection decisions and control small-group disclosures. Validate the intended aggregates before collection begins, with analysts able to explain the reporting scope and limitations.

references.title: EEOC: Recruiting, hiring or promoting employees

execution.rationale: Specify demographic reporting fields, aggregation limits and access requirements for people/privacy review before collection.

metadata.supportReason: Lever/Ashby APIs support pipeline and candidate management. Interview design and evaluation criteria need human input.
